name: gl-glitch-displace
title: GlitchDisplace transition
description: Blocks of the image are displaced in a glitch that flashes into the incoming image. Load vendor/glintmotion/hyper-shader.js, then this file, then call HyperShader.init({ transitions: [{ time, shader: "gl-glitch-displace", duration }] }).
author: Matt DesLauriers
